summary: Tonix Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K to disclose the publication of a peer-reviewed manuscript in the Journal of Clinical Immunology reporting results from a Phase 1 study of TNX-1500, an anti-CD154 monoclonal antibody for organ transplant rejection and autoimmune diseases. The study involved 26 healthy adults across three ascending dose cohorts plus placebo. No special-situation transaction (merger, tender, spinoff, restructuring, etc.) is present. The filing is a routine disclosure of clinical trial results and forward-looking statements, not a corporate event triggering special-situations classification.
